explanation: Lent's 40 days, not counting Sundays, recall Jesus' 40 days of fasting in the desert. Ramadan lasts one lunar month: 29 or 30 days, depending on the moon.

claims.text: Lent lasts 40 days, not counting Sundays; from Ash Wednesday to Holy Saturday is 46 days.
Ramadan, a month of the lunar Islamic calendar, lasts 29 or 30 days.
Lent's 40 days recall the 40 days Jesus spent fasting in the desert, according to the Gospels.
The length of Ramadan depends on the new moon, by sighting or calculation.

claimResults.note: Arithmetic: Ash Wednesday is 46 days before Easter and six Sundays fall inside, leaving 40. Eastern and Oriental Lents run longer (40 to 55 days), so Lent beats Ramadan under every count.
